title: 旅行专家打赌：行李费不会降，乘客会习惯吗？
speaker: Katy Nastro

segments.en: I'm starting to get very mad at David Gura who was taking his vacation now, and it's partly already planned this, whereas I was waiting to the end of summer. And the shoulder season is a good deal.
segments.zh: 我开始对David Gura很生气，他现在就去度假了，而且早就计划好了，而我还在等夏末。淡季出行其实很划算。

segments.en: But my concern is that when we see industries raise these prices, they don't tend to go back down, because consumers get used to it that threshold sticks. We very rarely if oil prices go down or see those other prices go back down.
segments.zh: 但我担心的是，一旦行业提高这些价格，它们往往不会回落，因为消费者会习惯，这个门槛就固定了。即使油价下跌，我们也很少看到其他价格回落。

segments.en: Do you think these increased bag fees will stay at this level? I really hope I'm wrong, but I am not a betting woman, but I would bet that these fees are here to stay.
segments.zh: 你觉得这些提高的行李费会维持在这个水平吗？我真希望我错了，但我不爱打赌，不过我愿意打赌这些费用会持续下去。

segments.en: They're pretty sticky historically. We have seen bag fees risen every few years. And it's likely that this was in airline's playbook all along, but we have this perfect time frame now to raise fees and have a justification to do so.
segments.zh: 从历史上看，它们相当顽固。我们看到行李费每隔几年就会上涨。这很可能一直是航司的既定策略，只是现在正好有合适的时机和理由来涨价。

segments.en: As well as, you know, JetBlue really started the trend and then United joined. And if you noticed, it's a herd mentality. You know, if one airline does it, it's a green light for everybody else. And unfortunately again, travelers are looking at this to be the new norm.
segments.zh: 而且，捷蓝航空开了先河，美联航跟进。如果你注意到了，这就是一种跟风心态。一家航司这么做，就等于给其他航司开了绿灯。不幸的是，旅客们不得不把这视为新常态。
